### STOP! Please Read Before Filing

**DO NOT post active security vulnerabilities publicly on GitHub issues.**

To ensure the safety of all FileX operators, we enforce a strict **Responsible Disclosure Policy**. 

Please report all vulnerabilities privately:
1. **Confidential Email:** Send detailed findings directly to **[security@filex.io](mailto:security@filex.io)**.
2. **Details:** Include steps to reproduce, impact assessment, and proof-of-concept scripts.

Maintainers will evaluate and patch the issue promptly. Thank you for keeping FileX safe!
